A '''double-helix prismatic crystal''' was fitted to [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to generate a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] beam. Double-helix prismatic crystals has an estimated lifespan of 20,000 shots before needing replacement, as each bolt eroded the crystal slightly when fired.
